PASSIVE RARE-LIFETIME IDENTIFICATION: OBSTRUCTION AND NATIVE REPAIR
Construction and audit, 1 November 2026

This note complements the root's rare coarse-target mean/deadline theorem.
It gives (1) a finite passive-information obstruction without hidden states,
(2) an explicit way to remove clamps and null-event marks from the declared
heatbath-plus-directed-cycle architecture, and (3) finite confidence and
exposure bounds. It does not claim that the source architecture can itself
be certified from a short ordinary trajectory.

CORPUS BINDING AND ORDINARY COMPARATOR

Prior Astra ingredients are bound to revision
51ce47ce39f976517d60e2f87bbe280b651f6056 of
harjassand/astra-research-knowledge. In particular N1213 is
research/2026-10-29-rare-means-and-finite-width/source/p1-final/ACQUISITION_SCIENCE.md
(GitHub blob df1394f2ae3b6338b5627554f6b6a8bac7dfbbc9).
Its local acquisition theorem assumes a known dependency graph, positive
reversible heatbath dynamics, calibrated unit site clocks, local clamps, and
marked refresh observations. Locality, refresh law, controllability and clock
scale remain separate warranties. Its passive invisible-clock obstruction is
accepted; the construction below strengthens the obstruction to fully observed
bounded-rate chains with a common known invariant law and a fast FULL gap.

Counts divided by occupation times are established CTMC/CTBN machinery, not a
new operation: Nodelman, Shelton and Koller, UAI 2003, Section 3 and equation (2),
https://arxiv.org/pdf/1212.2498 . Classical CTBNs there have single-site jumps;
the same counting-process likelihood applies to identifiable multi-site jump
masks. General trajectory learning must pay for rare rows: Wolfer and
Kontorovich, ALT 2019, https://proceedings.mlr.press/v98/wolfer19a.html .
Gaitonde, Moitra and Mossel already learn Ising models from actual transitions
without null marks for a broad reversible single-site class:
https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.15173 and
https://proceedings.mlr.press/v336/gaitonde26a.html . Their result does not
automatically identify the driven mixture used here. The explicit clean local
patterns below supply that missing component separation for this architecture.

This is a task-derived instantiation of an existing strong uncertainty
framework, not a refutation of that framework and not a novelty claim.

and deadline brackets for this cylinder, even for nonmonotone actual
rates and unknown actual stationary law. The entropy failure below
remains informative but is insufficient to establish a missing capability
for this target. The parent consequently strengthened the target geometry.

## Existing machinery actually attempted

Birrell, Katsoulakis and Rey-Bellet2021, "Quantification of model uncertainty
on path-space via goal-oriented relative entropy", ESAIM M2AN55,131--169:
https://www.numdam.org/item/10.1051/m2an/2020070.pdf .

cumulant-generating function at parameters lambda>K, given a stopped
relative-entropy bound eta0+K E_actual[tau]. AppendixD.2 gives the CTMC
stopped likelihood. Corollary4.3 Eq(4.3), building on Theorem3.6, also
permits a state-dependent entropy compensator. Corollary4.3 Eq(4.2) and
data processing permit comparison on the smaller sigma-algebra generated
by the desired observable; obtaining a useful computable divergence on
that sigma-algebra is a separate task. Remark3.8 discusses constant and
random entropy budgets in the exponential bound. These are established
mean/CDF model-error methods and should be credited as such.
